title: access.yaml
description: Who sees what: the access mode, protected-tag grants, roles with denials and row filters, and restrictions on metrics and fields.

status.description: Whether the owner has signed off this access file. Tools only write draft; sl approve sets approved.

approved_by.description: Who approved it. Required when status is approved.

approved_at.description: ISO date of approval, YYYY-MM-DD. Required when status is approved.

mode.description: open (the default): everyone sees every approved item minus protected tags, restrictions and the denials of the roles they hold; allow.models has no effect. closed: a user sees only what allow.models of a role they hold matches, minus the same; every role needs allow.models.

default_role.description: Role a user holds when they hold no other role.

user_attributes.description: Attributes a user carries, read by row filters as {{ user.<name> }}, by hierarchy filters, and by conditions (assign_when, restrictions' allow.when) as user.<name>.

roles.description: Roles. A user may hold several: those the identity system assigns by name and those whose assign_when holds; an item is visible when any held role makes it visible. Optional in open mode.

restrictions.description: Grants on metrics and fields, applied in both modes after role visibility: a target is visible only to users who hold one of allow.roles or satisfy allow.when.

open_questions.description: Questions about access still open with the owner; sl status counts them.

type.description: Value type; a _list binds as a list for IN and is tested with in or contains in conditions.

description.description: Who holds this role and what it sees.

assign_when.description: A condition over user attributes, such as user.department == 'finance'; the role is held whenever it is true, as well as when the identity system assigns the role by name.

models.description: Scope patterns over source.model names, such as warehouse.* or warehouse.orders. Required in closed mode; no effect in open mode.

tags.description: Protected tags (pii, sensitive) whose models and fields the role may see.

deny.description: What the role does not see, subtracted from what it would otherwise see.

fields.description: Dimensions and measures as source.model.field. A join cannot be named here: it is hidden from the role when its target model is not allowed or is denied.

tags.description: Tags whose models, dimensions, measures and metrics this role does not see.

row_filters.description: Rows of a model the role sees: a SQL predicate (expr) or a span-of-control rule (hierarchy). On the query's base model a row filter goes in WHERE; on a joined model it goes in that join's ON clause, so a left join keeps the row with blank joined columns and an inner join drops it. Several on one model within a role combine with AND; across held roles, the user sees the union.

open_questions.description: Questions about this role still open with the owner; sl status counts them.

row_filter.description: A row filter: exactly one of expr and hierarchy.

expr.description: SQL predicate over the model's own columns, with no subquery or other table; {{ user.<attribute> }} binds as a parameter.

hierarchy.description: Rows whose column is the user's id (with include_self) or the id of anyone below the user in the closure model via: column = :user_id OR column IN (SELECT member FROM via WHERE manager = :user_id).

column.description: Column of the filtered model holding a person's id.

via.description: The closure model, as source.model in the filtered model's source: one row per manager and member pair at any depth. It is read without its own row filters.

manager.description: Column of via holding the manager's id.

member.description: Column of via holding the id of someone at any depth below that manager.

user.description: The user attribute holding the user's own id, as user.<name>; a user without it sees no rows of the model.

include_self.description: Whether the user's own rows are included. Default true.

restriction.description: A restriction: its targets are visible only to users who hold one of allow.roles or satisfy allow.when.

name.description: Restriction name, unique; a hidden item's reason is restricted:<name>.

targets.description: metric:<name>, source.model or source.model.field, with scope-pattern globs (metric:finance_*, warehouse.payroll.*).

allow.description: Who may see the targets: at least one of roles and when.

roles.description: Roles whose holders see the targets.

when.description: A condition over user attributes; users for whom it is true see the targets.
